verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן עַזָּ֑תָה וַיַּרְא־ שָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ šim·šō·wn ‘az·zā·ṯāh way·yar- šām ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā
verses.literal: One day Samson went to Gaza where . . . he saw a prostitute and went in to spend the night with her
verses.literalPt: Sansão foi a Gaza, e viu ali uma prostituta e entrou a ela.

verses.original: לַֽעַזָּתִ֣ים׀ לֵאמֹ֗ר בָּ֤א שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ הֵ֔נָּה וַיָּסֹ֛בּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־ ל֥וֹ כָל־ הַלַּ֖יְלָה בְּשַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֑יר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁ֤וּ כָל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עַד־ א֥וֹר הַבֹּ֖קֶר וַהֲרְגְנֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘az·zā·ṯîm lê·mōr bā šim·šō·wn hên·nāh way·yā·sōb·bū way·ye·’er·ḇū- lōw ḵāl hal·lay·lāh bə·ša·‘ar hā·‘îr way·yiṯ·ḥā·rə·šū ḵāl hal·lay·lāh lê·mōr ‘aḏ- ’ō·wr hab·bō·qer wa·hăr·ḡə·nu·hū
verses.literal: When the Gazites heard that Samson was there they surrounded that place and lay in wait for him all night at the city gate They were quiet throughout the night saying Let us wait until dawn . . . then we will kill him
verses.literalPt: Foi dito aos gazitas: Sansão é chegado aqui. Cercaram-no e esperaram-no às escondidas na porta da cidade, e ficaram quietos toda a noite, dizendo: Quando raiar o dia, matá-lo-emos.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב שִׁמְשׁוֹן֮ עַד־ חֲצִ֣י הַלַּיְלָה֒ וַיָּ֣קָם׀ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֗יְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹ֞ז בְּדַלְת֤וֹת שַֽׁעַר־ הָעִיר֙ וּבִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּז֔וֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם֙ עִֽם־ הַבְּרִ֔יחַ וַיָּ֖שֶׂם עַל־ כְּתֵפָ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲלֵם֙ אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḇ šim·šō·wn ‘aḏ- ḥă·ṣî hal·lay·lāh way·yā·qām ba·ḥă·ṣî hal·lay·lāh way·ye·’ĕ·ḥōz bə·ḏal·ṯō·wṯ ša·‘ar- hā·‘îr ū·ḇiš·tê ham·mə·zū·zō·wṯ way·yis·sā·‘êm ‘im- hab·bə·rî·aḥ way·yā·śem ‘al- kə·ṯê·p̄āw way·ya·‘ă·lêm ’el- rōš hā·hār ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê ḥeḇ·rō·wn
verses.literal: But Samson lay there only until midnight . . . when he got up - took hold of the doors of the city gate and both gateposts and pulled them out bar and all Then he put them on his shoulders and took them to the top of the mountain overlooking . . . Hebron
verses.literalPt: Porém Sansão deitou-se até à meia-noite, tempo em que se levantou, e pegou nas duas meias portas da cidade e nas duas ombreiras, arrancou-as juntamente com a tranca e, pondo-as sobre os ombros, levou-as até o cume do monte que está defronte de Hebrom.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנַ֣חַל שֹׂרֵ֑ק וּשְׁמָ֖הּ דְּלִילָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên way·ye·’ĕ·haḇ ’iš·šāh bə·na·ḥal śō·rêq ū·šə·māh də·lî·lāh
verses.literal: Some time later . . . Samson fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah
verses.literalPt: Depois disso se afeiçoou a uma mulher que morava no vale de Soreque, e que se chamava Dalila.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יהָ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ לָ֜הּ פַּתִּ֣י אוֹת֗וֹ וּרְאִי֙ בַּמֶּה֙ כֹּח֣וֹ גָד֔וֹל וּבַמֶּה֙ נ֣וּכַל ל֔וֹ וַאֲסַרְנֻ֖הוּ לְעַנֹּת֑וֹ וַאֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נִתַּן־ לָ֔ךְ אִ֕ישׁ אֶ֥לֶף וּמֵאָ֖ה כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ’ê·le·hā sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yō·mə·rū lāh pat·tî ’ō·w·ṯōw ū·rə·’î bam·meh kō·ḥōw ḡā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇam·meh nū·ḵal lōw wa·’ă·sar·nu·hū lə·‘an·nō·ṯōw wa·’ă·naḥ·nū nit·tan- lāḵ ’îš ’e·lep̄ ū·mê·’āh kā·sep̄
verses.literal: The lords of the Philistines went to her and said Entice him and find out the source of his great strength and how we can overpower him to tie him up and subdue him Then each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels . . . of silver
verses.literalPt: Subiram a ter com ela os régulos dos filisteus e disseram-lhe: Persuade-lhe que descubra donde lhe vem tamanha força e de que modo o poderemos vencer, a fim de o amarrarmos para o atormentar; e nós te daremos, cada um de nós, mil e cem siclos de prata.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל־ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הַגִּֽידָה־ נָּ֣א לִ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה כֹּחֲךָ֣ גָד֑וֹל וּבַמֶּ֥ה תֵאָסֵ֖ר לְעַנּוֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer də·lî·lāh ’el- šim·šō·wn hag·gî·ḏāh- nā lî bam·meh kō·ḥă·ḵā ḡā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇam·meh ṯê·’ā·sêr lə·‘an·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: So Delilah said to Samson Please tell me the source of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued
verses.literalPt: Disse Dalila a Sansão: Declara-me donde te vem tamanha força e de que modo poderás ser amarrado para sofrer tormentos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אִם־ יַאַסְרֻ֗נִי בְּשִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ חֹרָ֑בוּ וְחָלִ֥יתִי וְהָיִ֖יתִי כְּאַחַ֥ד הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā šim·šō·wn ’im- ya·’as·ru·nî bə·šiḇ·‘āh yə·ṯā·rîm la·ḥîm ’ă·šer lō- ḥō·rå̄·ḇū wə·ḥā·lî·ṯî wə·hā·yî·ṯî kə·’a·ḥaḏ hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Samson told her . . . If they tie me up with seven fresh bowstrings that have not been dried I will become as weak . . . as any other man
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Sansão: Se me amarrassem com sete cordas de nervos, ainda não secados, tornar-me-ia fraco, e seria como qualquer outro homem.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲלוּ־ לָ֞הּ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים שִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ חֹרָ֑בוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵ֖הוּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū- lāh sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm šiḇ·‘āh yə·ṯā·rîm la·ḥîm ’ă·šer lō- ḥō·rā·ḇū wat·ta·’as·rê·hū bā·hem
verses.literal: So the lords of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that had not been dried and she tied him up with them
verses.literalPt: Trouxeram-lhe os régulos dos filisteus sete cordas de nervos, ainda não secados, com as quais ela o amarrou.

verses.original: וְהָאֹרֵ֗ב יֹשֵׁ֥ב לָהּ֙ בַּחֶ֔דֶר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖יךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיְנַתֵּק֙ אֶת־ הַיְתָרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִנָּתֵ֤ק פְּתִֽיל־ הַנְּעֹ֙רֶת֙ בַּהֲרִיח֣וֹ אֵ֔שׁ וְלֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע כֹּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ō·rêḇ yō·šêḇ lāh ba·ḥe·ḏer wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw pə·liš·tîm ‘ā·le·ḵā šim·šō·wn way·nat·têq ’eṯ- hay·ṯā·rîm ka·’ă·šer yin·nā·ṯêq pə·ṯîl- han·nə·‘ō·reṯ ba·hă·rî·ḥōw ’êš wə·lō nō·w·ḏa‘ kō·ḥōw
verses.literal: While the men were hidden in her room she called out Samson the Philistines are here But he snapped the bowstrings like a strand of yarn seared . . . by a flame So the source of his strength remained unknown . . .
verses.literalPt: Ora tinha ela homens que esperavam escondidos na câmara interior. Disse-lhe: Os filisteus vêm sobre ti, Sansão! Ele quebrou as cordas como se quebra o fio da estopa ao chegar-lhe o cheiro do fogo. Assim, não se soube donde lhe vinha a força.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל־ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הִנֵּה֙ הֵתַ֣לְתָּ בִּ֔י וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י כְּזָבִ֑ים עַתָּה֙ הַגִּֽידָה־ נָּ֣א לִ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה תֵּאָסֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer də·lî·lāh ’el- šim·šō·wn hin·nêh hê·ṯal·tā bî wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay kə·zā·ḇîm ‘at·tāh hag·gî·ḏāh- nā lî bam·meh tê·’ā·sêr
verses.literal: Then Delilah said to Samson . . . You have mocked me and lied to me . . . . . . Now please tell me how you can be tied up
verses.literalPt: Disse Dalila a Sansão: Eis que zombaste de mim e me disseste mentiras; agora, dize-me de que modo poderás ser amarrado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אִם־ אָס֤וֹר יַאַסְר֙וּנִי֙ בַּעֲבֹתִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בָהֶ֖ם מְלָאכָ֑ה וְחָלִ֥יתִי וְהָיִ֖יתִי כְּאַחַ֥ד הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’im- ’ā·sō·wr ya·’as·rū·nî ba·‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm ḥă·ḏā·šîm ’ă·šer lō- na·‘ă·śāh ḇā·hem mə·lā·ḵāh wə·ḥā·lî·ṯî wə·hā·yî·ṯî kə·’a·ḥaḏ hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: He replied . . . If they tie me up . . . with new ropes that have never been used . . . . . . I will become as weak . . . as any other man
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe ele: Se me amarrassem bem com cordas novas, que ainda não houvessem sido usadas para obra alguma, tornar-me-ia fraco e seria como qualquer outro homem.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח דְּלִילָה֩ עֲבֹתִ֨ים חֲדָשִׁ֜ים וַתַּאַסְרֵ֣הוּ בָהֶ֗ם וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֤ים עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן וְהָאֹרֵ֖ב יֹשֵׁ֣ב בֶּחָ֑דֶר וַֽיְנַתְּקֵ֛ם מֵעַ֥ל זְרֹעֹתָ֖יו כַּחֽוּט׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ də·lî·lāh ‘ă·ḇō·ṯîm ḥă·ḏā·šîm wat·ta·’as·rê·hū ḇā·hem wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw pə·liš·tîm ‘ā·le·ḵā šim·šō·wn wə·hā·’ō·rêḇ yō·šêḇ be·ḥā·ḏer way·nat·tə·qêm mê·‘al zə·rō·‘ō·ṯāw ka·ḥūṭ
verses.literal: So Delilah took new ropes tied him up with them and called out . . . Samson the Philistines are here But while the men were hidden in her room he snapped the ropes off his arms like they were threads
verses.literalPt: Dalila tomou cordas novas, e amarrou-o com elas, e disse-lhe: Os filisteus vêm sobre ti, Sansão! Ora, os homens esperavam escondidos na câmara interior. Ele as quebrou dos seus braços como um fio.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר דְּלִילָ֜ה אֶל־ שִׁמְשׁ֗וֹן עַד־ הֵ֜נָּה הֵתַ֤לְתָּ בִּי֙ וַתְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלַי֙ כְּזָבִ֔ים הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה תֵּאָסֵ֑ר וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אִם־ תַּאַרְגִ֗י אֶת־ שֶׁ֛בַע מַחְלְפ֥וֹת רֹאשִׁ֖י עִם־ הַמַּסָּֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer də·lî·lāh ’el- šim·šō·wn ‘aḏ- hên·nāh hê·ṯal·tā bî wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay kə·zā·ḇîm hag·gî·ḏāh lî bam·meh tê·’ā·sêr way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ’im- ta·’ar·ḡî ’eṯ- še·ḇa‘ maḥ·lə·p̄ō·wṯ rō·šî ‘im- ham·mas·sā·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: Then Delilah said to Samson You have mocked me and lied to me . . . . . . all along Tell me how you can be tied up He told her . . . If you weave the seven braids of my head into the web of a loom and tighten it with a pin, I will become as weak as any other man.
verses.literalPt: Disse Dalila a Sansão: Até agora, tens zombado de mim e me tens dito mentiras; dize-me de que modo poderás ser amarrado. Respondeu-lhe ele: Se teceres as sete tranças dos cabelos da minha cabeça com a urdidura da teia.

verses.original: וַתִּתְקַע֙ בַּיָּתֵ֔ד וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖יךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיִּיקַץ֙ מִשְּׁנָת֔וֹ וַיִּסַּ֛ע אֶת־ הַיְתַ֥ד הָאֶ֖רֶג וְאֶת־ הַמַּסָּֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṯ·qa‘ bay·yā·ṯêḏ wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw pə·liš·tîm ‘ā·le·ḵā šim·šō·wn way·yî·qaṣ miš·šə·nā·ṯōw way·yis·sa‘ ’eṯ- hay·ṯaḏ hā·’e·reḡ wə·’eṯ- ham·mas·sā·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: So while he slept, Delilah took the seven braids of his hair and wove them into the web. with a pin and called to him Samson the Philistines are here But he awoke from his sleep and pulled out the pin with the loom and the web
verses.literalPt: Ela as fixou com o torno do tear e disse-lhe: Os filisteus vêm sobre ti, Sansão! Ele, despertando do sono, arrancou o torno, o tear e a teia.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמַ֣ר אֲהַבְתִּ֔יךְ וְלִבְּךָ֖ אֵ֣ין אִתִּ֑י זֶ֣ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ הֵתַ֣לְתָּ בִּ֔י וְלֹא־ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה כֹּחֲךָ֥ גָדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw ’êḵ tō·mar ’ă·haḇ·tîḵ wə·lib·bə·ḵā ’ên ’it·tî zeh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm hê·ṯal·tā bî wə·lō- hig·gaḏ·tā lî bam·meh kō·ḥă·ḵā ḡā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: How can you say . . . I love you she asked when your heart is not with me This is the third time you have mocked me and failed to reveal to me the source of your great strength . . .
verses.literalPt: Ela lhe disse: Como podes dizer que me amas, quando não confias em mim? Já três vezes tens zombado de mim e não me tens dito donde te vem a tua grande força.

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִי כִּֽי־ הֵצִ֨יקָה לּ֧וֹ בִדְבָרֶ֛יהָ כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֖ים וַתְּאַֽלֲצֵ֑הוּ וַתִּקְצַ֥ר נַפְשׁ֖וֹ לָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- hê·ṣî·qāh lōw ḇiḏ·ḇā·re·hā kāl- hay·yā·mîm wat·tə·’a·lă·ṣê·hū wat·tiq·ṣar nap̄·šōw lā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Finally, after she had pressed him daily with her words and pleaded until he was sick to death
verses.literalPt: Importunando-o ela todos os dias com as suas palavras e molestando-o, a alma dele angustiou-se até a morte.

verses.original: וַיַּגֶּד־ לָ֣הּ אֶת־ כָּל־ לִבּ֗וֹ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהּ֙ מוֹרָה֙ לֹֽא־ עָלָ֣ה עַל־ רֹאשִׁ֔י כִּֽי־ נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲנִ֖י מִבֶּ֣טֶן אִמִּ֑י אִם־ גֻּלַּ֙חְתִּי֙ וְסָ֣ר מִמֶּ֣נִּי כֹחִ֔י וְחָלִ֥יתִי וְהָיִ֖יתִי כְּכָל־ הָאָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yag·geḏ- lāh ’eṯ- kāl- lib·bōw way·yō·mer lāh mō·w·rāh lō- ‘ā·lāh ‘al- rō·šî kî- nə·zîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·nî mib·be·ṭen ’im·mî ’im- gul·laḥ·tî wə·sār mim·men·nî ḵō·ḥî wə·ḥā·lî·ṯî wə·hā·yî·ṯî kə·ḵāl- hā·’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Samson told her all that was in his heart - My hair has never been cut . . . . . . because I have been a Nazirite to God from my mother’s womb If I am shaved my strength will leave me and I will become as weak as any other man
verses.literalPt: Descobriu-lhe todo o seu coração e disse-lhe: Nunca passou navalha pela minha cabeça; porque tenho sido nazireu para com Deus desde o ventre de minha mãe. Se me fosse rapada a cabeça, ir-se-ia de mim a minha força, tornar-me-ia fraco e seria como qualquer outro homem.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֣רֶא דְלִילָ֗ה כִּֽי־ הִגִּ֣יד לָהּ֮ אֶת־ כָּל־ לִבּוֹ֒ וַתִּשְׁלַ֡ח וַתִּקְרָא֩ לְסַרְנֵ֨י פְלִשְׁתִּ֤ים לֵאמֹר֙ עֲל֣וּ הַפַּ֔עַם כִּֽי־ הִגִּ֥יד לָהּ אֶת־ כָּל־ לִבּ֑וֹ וְעָל֤וּ אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיַּעֲל֥וּ הַכֶּ֖סֶף בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·re də·lî·lāh kî- hig·gîḏ lāh ’eṯ- kāl- lib·bōw wat·tiš·laḥ wat·tiq·rā lə·sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm lê·mōr ‘ă·lū hap·pa·‘am kî- hig·gîḏ lå̄h ’eṯ- kāl- lib·bōw wə·‘ā·lū ’ê·le·hā sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·ya·‘ă·lū hak·ke·sep̄ bə·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: When Delilah realized that he had revealed to her all that was in his heart she sent . . . this message to the lords of the Philistines Come up once more for he has revealed to me all that is in his heart Then the lords of the Philistines came to her bringing the money in their hands
verses.literalPt: Vendo Dalila que ele lhe descobrira todo o seu coração, mandou chamar os régulos dos filisteus, dizendo: Subi esta vez, porque agora me descobriu ele todo o seu coração. Então, os régulos dos filisteus subiram a ter com ela e trouxeram o dinheiro nas suas mãos.

verses.original: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ בִּרְכֶּ֔יהָ וַתִּקְרָ֣א לָאִ֔ישׁ וַתְּגַלַּ֕ח אֶת־ שֶׁ֖בַע מַחְלְפ֣וֹת רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַתָּ֙חֶל֙ לְעַנּוֹת֔וֹ וַיָּ֥סַר כֹּח֖וֹ מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·yaš·šə·nê·hū ‘al- bir·ke·hā wat·tiq·rā lā·’îš wat·tə·ḡal·laḥ ’eṯ- še·ḇa‘ maḥ·lə·p̄ō·wṯ rō·šōw wat·tā·ḥel lə·‘an·nō·w·ṯōw way·yā·sar kō·ḥōw mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: And having lulled him to sleep on her lap she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his head In this way she began to subdue him and his strength . . . left him
verses.literalPt: Ela fez que Sansão dormisse sobre os seus joelhos; e mandou chamar a um homem, e fez que cortasse as sete tranças dos cabelos da sua cabeça. Começou a atormentá-lo, e a sua força se lhe foi.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖יךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיִּקַ֣ץ מִשְּׁנָת֗וֹ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵצֵ֞א כְּפַ֤עַם בְּפַ֙עַם֙ וְאִנָּעֵ֔ר וְהוּא֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה סָ֥ר מֵעָלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer pə·liš·tîm ‘ā·le·ḵā šim·šō·wn way·yi·qaṣ miš·šə·nā·ṯōw way·yō·mer ’ê·ṣê kə·p̄a·‘am bə·p̄a·‘am wə·’in·nā·‘êr wə·hū lō yā·ḏa‘ kî Yah·weh sār mê·‘ā·lāw
verses.literal: Then she called out Samson the Philistines are here When Samson awoke from his sleep he thought I will escape as I did before . . . and shake myself free But he did not know that the LORD had departed from him
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe: Os filisteus vêm sobre ti, Sansão! Despertando ele do sono, disse: Sairei como nas outras ocasiões e me sacudirei. Porém não sabia que Jeová se havia retirado dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּאחֲז֣וּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽיְנַקְּר֖וּ אֶת־ עֵינָ֑יו וַיּוֹרִ֨ידוּ אוֹת֜וֹ עַזָּ֗תָה וַיַּאַסְר֙וּהוּ֙ בַּֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַיְהִ֥י טוֹחֵ֖ן בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֲסִירִים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḥă·zū·hū p̄ə·liš·tîm way·naq·qə·rū ’eṯ- ‘ê·nāw way·yō·w·rî·ḏū ’ō·w·ṯōw ‘az·zā·ṯāh way·ya·’as·rū·hū ban·ḥuš·ta·yim way·hî ṭō·w·ḥên bə·ḇêṯ hå̄·ʾă·sī·rīm
verses.literal: Then the Philistines seized him gouged out his eyes and brought him down to Gaza where he was bound with bronze shackles and forced to grind grain in the prison . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filisteus pegaram nele, e vazaram-lhe os olhos; e, tendo-o levado a Gaza, amarraram-no com cadeias de bronze e obrigaram-no a mover um moinho no cárcere.

verses.original: וַיָּ֧חֶל שְׂעַר־ רֹאשׁ֛וֹ לְצַמֵּ֖חַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר גֻּלָּֽח׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel śə·‘ar- rō·šōw lə·ṣam·mê·aḥ ka·’ă·šer gul·lāḥ
verses.literal: However, the hair of his head began to grow back after it had been shaved
verses.literalPt: Todavia, os cabelos da sua cabeça, logo que foram rapados, começaram a crescer de novo.

verses.original: וְסַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים נֶֽאֱסְפוּ֙ לִזְבֹּ֧חַ זֶֽבַח־ גָּד֛וֹל לְדָג֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וּלְשִׂמְחָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָתַ֤ן אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּיָדֵ֔נוּ אֵ֖ת שִׁמְשׁ֥וֹן אוֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm nɛ·ʾɛ̆s·p̄ū liz·bō·aḥ ze·ḇaḥ- gā·ḏō·wl lə·ḏā·ḡō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ū·lə·śim·ḥāh way·yō·mə·rū nā·ṯan ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū bə·yā·ḏê·nū ’êṯ šim·šō·wn ’ō·wy·ḇê·nū
verses.literal: Now the lords of the Philistines gathered together to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon They rejoiced and said Our god has delivered Samson our enemy into our hands
verses.literalPt: Os régulos dos filisteus reuniram-se para oferecer um grande sacrifício ao seu deus Dagom e para se regozijar; pois diziam: O nosso deus nos entregou nas mãos a Sansão, nosso inimigo.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְהַלְל֖וּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְר֗וּ נָתַ֨ן אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ בְיָדֵ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ א֣וֹיְבֵ֔נוּ וְאֵת֙ מַחֲרִ֣יב אַרְצֵ֔נוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִרְבָּ֖ה אֶת־ חֲלָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ’ō·ṯōw hā·‘ām way·hal·lū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem kî ’ā·mə·rū nā·ṯan ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ḇə·yā·ḏê·nū ’eṯ- ’ō·wy·ḇê·nū wə·’êṯ ma·ḥă·rîḇ ’ar·ṣê·nū wa·’ă·šer hir·bāh ’eṯ- ḥă·lā·lê·nū
verses.literal: And when the people saw him they praised their god saying Our god has delivered into our hands our enemy who destroyed our land and multiplied our dead
verses.literalPt: Quando o povo o viu, louvaram ao seu deus; pois diziam: O nosso deus nos entregou nas mãos o nosso inimigo e o destruidor do nosso país, que multiplicou os nossos mortos.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּי טוֹב לִבָּ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ קִרְא֥וּ לְשִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן וִישַֽׂחֶק־ לָ֑נוּ וַיִּקְרְא֨וּ לְשִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן מִבֵּ֣ית האסירים וַיְצַחֵק֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיַּעֲמִ֥ידוּ אוֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֥ין הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kī ṭōḇ lib·bām way·yō·mə·rū qir·’ū lə·šim·šō·wn wî·śa·ḥeq- lā·nū way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·šim·šō·wn mib·bêṯ h·s·rm way·ṣa·ḥêq lip̄·nê·hem way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏū ’ō·w·ṯōw bên hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm
verses.literal: And while their hearts were merry they said Call for Samson to entertain us So they called Samson out of the prison . . . to entertain them . . . And they stationed him between the pillars
verses.literalPt: Estando eles alegres, disseram: Mandai vir Sansão, para que nos divirta. Mandaram vir do cárcere Sansão que os divertia: e puseram-no entre as colunas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן אֶל־ הַנַּ֨עַר הַמַּחֲזִ֣יק בְּיָדוֹ֮ הַנִּ֣יחָה אוֹתִי֒ וְהֵימִשֵׁנִי אֶת־ הָֽעַמֻּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת נָכ֣וֹן עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֶשָּׁעֵ֖ן עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·šō·wn ’el- han·na·‘ar ham·ma·ḥă·zîq bə·yā·ḏōw han·nî·ḥāh ’ō·w·ṯî wə·hē·mi·šē·nī ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm ’ă·šer hab·ba·yiṯ nā·ḵō·wn ‘ă·lê·hem wə·’eš·šā·‘ên ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Samson said to the servant who held his hand Lead me where I can feel the pillars supporting the temple so I can lean . . . against them
verses.literalPt: Disse Sansão ao moço que o guiava pela mão: Deixa-me apalpar as colunas, em que se sustem a casa, para que a elas me encoste.

verses.original: וְהַבַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֤א הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וְהַנָּשִׁ֔ים וְשָׁ֕מָּה כֹּ֖ל סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְעַל־ הַגָּ֗ג כִּשְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֔ה הָרֹאִ֖ים בִּשְׂח֥וֹק שִׁמְשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·ba·yiṯ mā·lê hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·han·nā·šîm wə·šām·māh kōl sar·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm wə·‘al- hag·gāḡ kiš·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš wə·’iš·šāh hā·rō·’îm biś·ḥō·wq šim·šō·wn
verses.literal: Now the temple was full of men and women all the lords of the Philistines were there and about three thousand men and women were on the roof watching Samson entertain them
verses.literalPt: Ora, a casa estava cheia de homens e mulheres; estavam também ali todos os régulos dos filisteus; havia no telhado uns três mil homens e mulheres, que olhavam enquanto Sansão os divertia.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א שִׁמְשׁ֛וֹן אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֡ה זָכְרֵ֣נִי נָא֩ וְחַזְּקֵ֨נִי נָ֜א אַ֣ךְ הַפַּ֤עַם הַזֶּה֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְאִנָּקְמָ֧ה נְקַם־ אַחַ֛ת מִשְּׁתֵ֥י עֵינַ֖י מִפְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā šim·šō·wn ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh zā·ḵə·rê·nî nā wə·ḥaz·zə·qê·nî nā ’aḵ hap·pa·‘am haz·zeh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’in·nā·qə·māh nə·qam- ’a·ḥaṯ miš·šə·ṯê ‘ê·nay mip·pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Then Samson called out to the LORD . . . O Lord GOD please remember me Strengthen me . . . O God just once more . . . so that with one vengeful blow I may pay back the Philistines for my two eyes
verses.literalPt: Sansão clamou a Jeová e disse: Senhor Jeová, lembra-te de mim, e fortalece-me ainda esta vez, ó Deus, para que me vingue nos filisteus ao menos dum dos meus dois olhos.

verses.original: וַיִּלְפֹּ֨ת שִׁמְשׁ֜וֹן אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֣י׀ עַמּוּדֵ֣י הַתָּ֗וֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַבַּ֙יִת֙ נָכ֣וֹן עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּסָּמֵ֖ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד בִּימִינ֖וֹ וְאֶחָ֥ד בִּשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yil·pōṯ šim·šō·wn ’eṯ- šə·nê ‘am·mū·ḏê hat·tā·weḵ ’ă·šer hab·ba·yiṯ nā·ḵō·wn ‘ă·lê·hem way·yis·sā·mêḵ ‘ă·lê·hem ’e·ḥāḏ bî·mî·nōw wə·’e·ḥāḏ biś·mō·lōw
verses.literal: And Samson reached out for the two central pillars supporting the temple Bracing himself . . . against them with his right hand on one pillar and his left hand on the other
verses.literalPt: Abraçou-se Sansão com as duas colunas do meio, em que a casa se sustinha, e pegou nelas, numa com a mão direita, noutra com a mão esquerda

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שִׁמְשׁ֗וֹן תָּמ֣וֹת נַפְשִׁי֮ עִם־ פְּלִשְׁתִּים֒ וַיֵּ֣ט בְּכֹ֔חַ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל הַבַּ֙יִת֙ עַל־ הַסְּרָנִ֔ים וְעַל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ וַיִּהְי֤וּ הַמֵּתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵמִ֣ית בְּמוֹת֔וֹ רַבִּ֕ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵמִ֖ית בְּחַיָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šim·šō·wn tā·mō·wṯ nap̄·šî ‘im- pə·liš·tîm way·yêṭ bə·ḵō·aḥ way·yip·pōl hab·ba·yiṯ ‘al- has·sə·rā·nîm wə·‘al- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- bōw way·yih·yū ham·mê·ṯîm ’ă·šer hê·mîṯ bə·mō·w·ṯōw rab·bîm mê·’ă·šer hê·mîṯ bə·ḥay·yāw
verses.literal: Samson said Let me die with the Philistines Then he pushed with all his might and the temple fell on the lords and all the people in it So in his death he killed more than he had killed in his life
verses.literalPt: e disse: Morra eu com os filisteus. Empurrou com toda a sua força; e a casa caiu sobre os régulos e sobre todo o povo que nela estava. Assim, foram mais os mortos que matou na sua morte do que os que matou na sua vida.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֨וּ אֶחָ֜יו וְכָל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִיהוּ֮ וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ אֹתוֹ֒ וַֽיַּעֲל֣וּ׀ וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אוֹת֗וֹ בֵּ֤ין צָרְעָה֙ וּבֵ֣ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹ֔ל בְּקֶ֖בֶר מָנ֣וֹחַ אָבִ֑יו וְה֛וּא שָׁפַ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū ’e·ḥāw wə·ḵāl bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hū way·yiś·’ū ’ō·ṯōw way·ya·‘ă·lū way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·w·ṯōw bên ṣā·rə·‘āh ū·ḇên ’eš·tā·’ōl bə·qe·ḇer mā·nō·w·aḥ ’ā·ḇîw wə·hū šā·p̄aṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Then Samson’s brothers . . . and his father’s . . . family came down carried him back and buried him between Zorah . . . and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah And he had judged Israel twenty years
verses.literalPt: Então, desceram seus irmãos e toda a casa de seu pai, tomaram-no e, tendo voltado, sepultaram-no entre Zorá e Estaol, no lugar da sepultura de seu pai Manoá. Ele julgou a Israel vinte anos.
